_note: Governed mitigation records (REQ-DSP, rule 1). A mitigation names a control by inventory component ID, the control's fingerprint when the decision was made (build-vdr-report.py --ksi-signal ksi-signal.json --fingerprint COMPONENT_ID), and a verifying check. It is void when the control's fingerprint changes, when the check has no passing result for the control, when the control leaves the inventory, or past review_by; a void mitigation withdraws the clock reset it earned. effect: full (fully mitigated: NLEV at the lowest impact level; needs verifying_check.signal 'runtime', the signed runtime signal, verified and fresh), not-reachable (NIRV) or not-likely-exploitable (NLEV; never for a KEV). A vulnerability covered here is recorded in data/vuln-dispositions.json as 'mitigated', never as 'false-positive'.

MIT-000.justification: Why the control removes the exploit path, and how the check shows the control is in place.
